garamantasId: id in a local digital library repository Garamantas
workTitle: work title as in the primary source
witnessId: id for each variant if the variants are kept apart in seperate MEI files
multipart: true/false category representing whether there is a second/third voice (true). Most of the dataset consists of monodies though (false).
archivalSourceId: to reference any other ID in the library archive
PublishedID: song's id in the Latvian Folklore Archive
Screenshot: screenshots for metadata aggregation have been made (yes/true)
Identified (Yes): a new song to the dataset, identifed by expert (yes=verified by expert, included in the dataset)
dateSource: date when the song was transcribed
placeSource: city/district where the song was transcribed
placeSourcePast: represents an old form of naming the city/district
